newsitem.title: USA: Riser gets $42/shr offer from another chain.
newsitem.headline: Riser gets $42/shr offer from another chain.

text.p: Riser Foods Inc on Monday said it is considering an offer from another grocery supermarket chain to purchase all of its outstanding shares for $42 per share.

Riser stated that no definitive agreement has been reached and that the offer is subject to the approval of both parties, financing, required regulatory and shareholder approvals and other customary terms and conditions.
Riser shares closed at 37-5/8 per share on Friday.
Riser operates 36 retail supermarkets in northeast Ohio under the Rini-Rego Stop-n-Shop banner.
It did not identify the bidder.
